description: A Svelte 5 data grid as real estate listings: each card shows the house photo with its status and a save button, the price, beds, baths and size, the address and the agent, drawn by a card snippet. Status buttons and a bedroom filter set column filters, a sort menu sorts the grid, and the cards follow.

faq.question: Does sorting change the order of the cards?
faq.answer: Yes. The gallery draws the grid's rows in the grid's order, so api.setSort, a column filter or the search box all show on the wall at once.

faq.question: What does the card show when nothing matches?
faq.answer: The text in emptyText, here No listings match. It defaults to No records.

faq.question: Can a card hold its own buttons?
faq.answer: Yes. A card snippet is ordinary markup: the save button on each listing here toggles its own state. Without onCardClick the card itself is not a button, so its controls work on their own.
